messages:
anna.platform: heads-up — i'm going to propose a conservative rollout for the new routing-precedence flag (route_priority_prefer_cached). want checkpointed snapshots per cohort + a clear rollback hook. :eyes:

mike.ops: sounds good. can we gate by both error-rate and latency regressions? suggested thresholds: +5% error OR +10% p95 latency.

sanjay.eng: agree. we should also persist the exact config snapshot to S3 with metadata (commit, user, cohort) so ops can replay if needed.

lee.devexp: small UX ask — console should show a before/after diff for the snapshot and a one-click revert that includes a reason field. otherwise people will hand-roll and we lose audit. :thumbsup:

maya.product: question — what TTL do we want on temporary overrides for canary cohorts? last time someone forgot to clear a 100% roll for a week.

mike.ops: default TTL 24h for transient overrides, with console warning if >72h. we can add automatic expiry hooks.

anna.platform: good. proposal summary: 1) snapshot on rollout start 2) apply to cohort(s) 3) attach telemetry gating rules 4) automated rollback trigger (error/latency) 5) TTL on transient overrides + audit fields.

lee.devexp: example console flow mock: "Create rollout -> snapshot saved -> live diff -> schedule -> live monitor -> auto-rollback button". also show last snapshot checksum.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook link added to thread: /runbooks/config-rollout-checkpoint (auto note).

mike.ops: telemetry gating snippet i sketched for prometheus: 
```
alert: ConfigRolloutRegression
expr: increase(http_requests_errors_total{cohort="canary"}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total{cohort="canary"}[5m]) > 0.05
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/config-rollout
  summary: "Config rollout caused >5% error increase in canary cohort"
```

sanjay.eng: and a replay hook: curl snapshot api to revert —
`curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/configs/snapshot/revert -d '{"snapshot_id":"s-202311-abc123","reason":"auto-rollback error spike"}'`

maya.product: please add a dashboard tile that shows "active rollouts" with cohort, age, snapshot id, and gating status. product and PMs need one glance.

anna.platform: action items: @mike.ops add prometheus rule and alert integration w/ops-bot; @lee.devexp add snapshot+diff UX mock; @sanjay.eng implement snapshot API + S3 metadata; @maya.product wire dashboard reqs. i'll draft the rollout playbook (short) and ping infra for S3 policy.

mike.ops: i'll also add a temporary lint in console to warn if override TTL >72h and require manual confirmation.

lee.devexp: quick UX note — include a compact human-readable diff for flags and a JSON viewer for full details. users will paste JSON during reviews.

anna.platform: thanks all. if nobody objects i'll start the playbook doc and a canary in staging tomorrow. ping here if you want to join the sync. :rocket:
